title.narrative: DIBE 2025 - Cold A/S - Innovative Mobile and Climate friendly flood prevention in the Philippines

description.narrative: The main purpose of this project is to demonstrate an alternative solution to the environment disastrous utilisation of sandbags and replacing those with long lasting PVC barriers. Providing for a mobile and fast solution which will eliminate the filling of sandbags, transporting those to several protection points and avoid the enormous sand cleaning processes from the many destroyed sandbags by replacing those with Cold Flood Prevention. Flood prevention team would be strengthened in their preparedness with a smart and effective solution, the environment would be less impacted from flooding by eliminating the devastating sand spreading and the country would benefit from less flooding cleaning processes, thereby reducing direct cost.
